minecraft:written_book_content.author: Archivist P. Sallow
pages: {"text": "I kept the Guild's archive. Every register came across my desk.\n\nThe black gets into ink. Pages copied from the gatehouses darken by themselves, a little more every day."}
{"text": "My hands have gone the colour of the pages. The village nailed the door shut and I do not blame them.\n\nI am still lucid most days."}
{"text": "A golden apple and a draught of weakness would do it. The old cure. Nobody will bring me either.\n\nIf you do, I can trade you what I saved from the archive."}
{"text": "The registers all end the same way. The gate does not close as fast as it opens.\n\nSomeone has to close the first one. P.S."}
